integrity.mathematical_evidence: Exhaustive exact-integer successor graph with all cycles, basin assignments, transient distances checked by standalone standard-library script.
integrity.publication_priority: Not independently established beyond inspected material.

scientific_limitations: Exact exhaustive finite-state census only at beta=3/2 and the specified binary16 operations and endpoint convention.
Basin sizes count binary16 encodings uniformly, not Lebesgue-measure basins on the real interval.
No claim for compiler-dependent contraction, other precision, stochastic rounding or arbitrary beta.
The 2023 article references supplementary exact invariant-measure figures; no full supplementary file was accessible for a complete duplicate comparison.
title: Two exact cycle spectra for differently rounded half-precision beta shifts
